method.first_propagation: Walsh-Hadamard transform over chirp structure, 8 butterfly stages
method.layers_1_to_30: returned as zeros; only layer 0 and layer 31 carry estimates

development_evidence.cohort_note: different network set from the graded AIcrowd cohort; do not chain numbers across the two

arms.arm: Kerdock/MUB 5-design, Winograd propagation, fused final reduction
arms.note: later build than the graded archive; 33816576 fewer tracked ops from the fused reduction

basis_count_curve.note: literal prefix of the original basis order, no statistical correction; archived exposed-split projection, official arms never run
basis_count_curve.conclusion: exponent above 1 means the adjusted-score curve favors the full 129 bases; no partial arm was competitive

arithmetic_variants.outcome: A43 was NOT promoted: it saved the projected tracked FLOPs but paid ~2.2 s extra charged residual wall time per network, a net loss under the effective-compute model and a breach of the self-imposed 30 s predict-time limit (the grader hard cap is 60 s; the lower local limit was held because the development machine runs faster than the grader)

final_reduction_form.reason: 33816576 fewer tracked operations deterministically; the 1.5 ms residual difference sits inside the per-network standard deviation

negative_results: shared-reference first- and second-order Taylor evaluation of a heteroscedastic mixture state: recentering on the pooled-within covariance shrank covariance offsets but did not reduce approximation error; the error is mean-offset dominated
low-rank Hermite / direct-diagonal extraction: the accuracy gate needed rank 128, at which 2*n^2*r is approximately n^3 and the low-rank route costs the same as the dense one
layer-31 independent anchor corrections: propagated centre sits near 0.65% error where roughly 0.45% is break-even, so no candidate cleared the downstream-weighted replacement threshold
partial-MUB and companion-basis hosted controls: measured hurdle at 96 bases was 1.2841x raw gain at +5B, against a 1.0670x published projection; nothing available cleared even the published bar
learned sign/scale models and handcrafted weight features: no demonstrated complete-score value after actual compute cost
limitations: public-split numbers only; the 50-MLP private split is sealed
layers 1 to 30 are returned as zeros, so this is a final-layer estimator and not a full activation-profile estimator
the estimator is specialized to width 256 and depth 32 and returns zeros otherwise
residual wall time is hardware-dependent; local timings come from one macOS arm64 machine with BLAS pinned
the basis-count ablation is an archived exposed-split projection, not an official four-arm measurement
the static-cubature optimality claims circulated in the external-review materials are scoped to the limiting kernel and a fixed node budget, and are not verified in this repository
